_comment: Applied-migration manifest for the migrations_immutable invariant. Only APPLIED revisions belong here; a migration file absent from this map is by definition unapplied and is therefore allowed. Format: {repo-relative path: sha256_hex}.
_m0_note: Intentionally empty: no migrations have been applied. M1 (bead LifeOS-6) writes the real schema migrations. --update re-hashes existing entries but never adds new ones, because a migration becomes applied only once it is actually applied to the database.
